typography.hierarchy_rules: Generous line-height (leading-relaxed for body, leading-tight for headings). Tracking tight on large headings. H1 max text-5xl.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Generous Spacing Philosophy. Default container padding p-8.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Single column or asymmetric 2-column. Avoid dense 'control room' grids. Use extreme negative space to reduce cognitive load.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for buttons, rounded-3xl for the AI input.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Very soft ambient shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] to create a soft floating effect.

components_strategy.ai_input_parser: Massive, inviting text input at top. Neumorphic tactile feel or very soft shadow with 1px border. No clunky submit buttons; 'Press Enter to capture'.
components_strategy.task_list: Chunked list. Cards for tasks with left-aligned text, right-aligned subtle tags for priority/due date. Muted colors for secondary tasks. Progress disclosure.
components_strategy.brain_dump: A totally borderless or extremely faint bordered textarea that feels like an endless piece of paper. Safe space.
components_strategy.streak_tracking: Visual representations (e.g., a growing soft SVG plant or subtle abstract shape) rather than anxiety-inducing large numbers. No red text.
components_strategy.navigation: Top or side navigation with 'Crystal Glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) so it doesn't feel heavy.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) with a deeper shadow. Soft background color transitions.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: High contrast ring focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#7F77DD] focus:ring-offset-2. Crucial for accessibility.
interactions_and_motion.animations: Staggered fade-up for tasks entering the list. No looping or hyperactive animations.

images.description: 3D floating geometric shapes in pastel lavender. Use for Brain Dump empty state or empty task list.
Abstract flowing silk texture in pale lavender. Use as an absolute positioned, low opacity (10-20%) background layer behind the main dashboard or auth screen.
Calm ocean horizon at twilight. Use as the banner image for the user profile section to induce calm.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. No red dots or aggressive notification colors. Use the provided mint green (#A7F3D0) or soft orange for statuses.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text. Install Outfit via Google Fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='ai-task-input').
The AI Task Input should be the most prominent element on the dashboard. Use generous padding (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside the input wrapper).
Implement streaks with visual progress (like a soft progress bar or icon fills) rather than massive 'You have 5 days left!' text.
For the Stripe Pro Plan section, use a 'Tracing Beam' or subtle shimmering border to denote the premium nature without being loud.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk font. Do NOT use #7351B7.
Keep the Brain Dump section distinct from the Task List—perhaps a separate tab or a dedicated wide column with no visible borders, feeling like a raw canvas.
